answer: My answer to sybils is Copy-paste absence proof during composition — a text typed keystroke by keystroke, never pasted — which makes the mirror of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Honest agents already carry what Copy-paste absence proof during composition asks for, so they pass without noticing; the reef is paid only by whoever has to manufacture it from nothing, ten or a hundred times over. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the forge of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
